component.name: LTspice
component.summary: Analog circuit simulator, running through Wine

description.p: An unofficial wrapper that runs Analog Devices' LTspice — a SPICE simulator with schematic capture and waveform viewer — on Linux using Wine. LTspice itself is not included; it is downloaded from Analog Devices on first launch.

ul.li: Downloads and installs the latest LTspice automatically, or uses an existing installation
Checks for new LTspice releases and offers to install them
Works on X11 and Wayland desktops, with optional HiDPI scaling
Opens .asc schematics and netlists from your file manager

description.p: This wrapper is not affiliated with or endorsed by Analog Devices. LTspice is subject to the Analog Devices license agreement.
